description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) of three different configurations of the MADLLM model across four datasets: PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score, ranging from 80% to 100%, while the horizontal axis lists the datasets. The bars are color-coded to represent different configurations: green for MADLLM, purple for MADLLM without feature embedding, and orange for MADLLM without skip embedding. The MADLLM configuration consistently shows the highest F1 Scores across all datasets, with the highest score being just below 100% for PSM. The MADLLM without feature embedding configuration generally has slightly lower F1 Scores than the MADLLM configuration, with the lowest score being around 85% for SWaT. The MADLLM without skip embedding configuration shows the lowest F1 Scores, with the lowest score being around 80% for SWaT. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
